name: MySQL MCP Server (Optimized)
description: An MCP server for MySQL that enables users to execute SQL queries, inspect table structures, and explore database schemas through a clean, SOLID-based architecture. It includes built-in security validations to protect against dangerous operations and ensure safe interaction with database resources.
